casting_basis: Selfie has measured median periodic F0 around 193 Hz, Butter 85 Hz and oldNerd 102 Hz. These estimates support distinct registers but do not verify donor gender, age, accent or acting. oldNerd is a source filename, not verified age metadata. Source recordings and outputs have not been human-listened.
profile_policy: Five new local profiles identify fictional synthetic roles. Existing profiles are preserved. No consent recording, verified-own-voice assertion, donor endorsement or real-child reference was created.

model.name: k2-fsa/OmniVoice
model.license_reason_from_model_card: Constraints from training data, e.g. Emilia
model.license_statement: Downloaded model card: code Apache-2.0; pre-trained model CC-BY-NC because of training-data constraints.

voice_design_implementation: Installed VoiceStudio /profiles kind=design with vd_states; valid OmniVoice gender/age/pitch/accent tags. Deterministic identity samples use32steps, seed42, speed1; saved references condition subsequent synthesis. No new model or service.
postprocessing: One constant gain per clip targets -20 dBFS non-silent RMS with a decoded MP3 peak cap of -2 dBFS. Mono 24 kHz, 64 kbit/s MP3. No pitch shift, time stretch or runtime speed change.
bulletin_timing: Six natural-speed clips must total no more than 46.6 seconds; the remaining time in the 47 second event may hold natural pauses. This is a fictional game bulletin, not an authentic 1947 recording or actual historical announcer.
runtime_assets: Only generated MP3 files and catalog.json. No donor, source or design reference WAV, model, service URL or private paths.
normalization: Whitespace collapse and trim; id = SHA-256(role + NUL + normalized UTF-8 text).slice(0,16). Original wording is unchanged.
cache_identity: Per-role hash of settings, profile ID and reference SHA-256. No runtime service dependency.
library_reference: prosjektbibliotek/OFFENTLIG_INVENTAR.md entry for debpalash/VoiceStudio. Existing VoiceStudio 0.5.6 and already installed OmniVoice/faster-whisper-small reused. No new model or service installed.
period_style_authenticity: UNVERIFIED; news is fictional voice design, not an archival imitation
